name: Default
shortDescription: Tyk open source API gateway with Redis, proxying and securing REST, GraphQL and gRPC APIs managed through the Gateway API.

alerts.message: There is no web UI. Manage APIs, keys and policies through the Gateway API under /tyk/, sending the generated TYK_GW_SECRET value in the X-Tyk-Authorization header, then call /tyk/reload/group to apply API changes.
